description: Machine-readable dependency graph for the 34 accepted Stage 11B application modules, derived from direct source inspection (not filenames/directory/domain-label inference). Used to plan the Stage 11C2 ES-module migration.
method: Regex-based static extraction with string-literal and comment exclusion (to avoid counting documentation-text mentions of function/constant names as real code dependencies), cross-checked by manual source inspection for ambiguous or high-risk findings (implicit React hook global, mount-call count, collision candidates).
